verdict.rationale: jo exposes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec (openapi.json) and a Swagger UI at /docs, which technically supports interactive, runnable API exploration, but the evidence explicitly notes there is no developer program or public API keys documented around it, so it isn't positioned as a user-facing API reference. Missing for 10: documented developer program, public API key access, official interactive API reference page with examples, and independent confirmation the Swagger UI is usable/runnable for external users.
